rule_findings: parse_conditions charges1800000 per recognized CREATE_COIN occurrence before parsing amount/hint and without any flags, zero-amount, ephemeral or same-block branch.
Zero amount is an admitted u64 amount; ret.addition_amount +=0 does not undo condition_cost. No condition-cost subtraction/refund was found in this pinned parser.
COST_CONDITIONS can add a generic500-condition surcharge after a free quota; it does not replace/exempt the1800000 CREATE rate.

Duplicate same-parent puzzlehash/amount output is rejected after charge, not deduplicated into a valid free output. Audited actual11637 outputs have unique fullcoinIDs and each step has distinct puzzlehash/amount pairs.

Pinned source includes test_ephemeral_non_ff_spend asserting CREATE_COIN_COST when an output is consumed in the same bundle. This test was read, not executed. Ephemeral status and mempool fast-forward/dedup are not creation-condition rebates.

All129 observed controller outputs emit message conditions, which disable mempool spend dedup in MempoolVisitor. Consensus fixed occurrence charging is independent of that optional mempool eligibility visitor.
The condition-count claim preserves the emitted zero-mojo slot CREATE conditions. It is not a lower bound on every redesigned/more efficient protocol implementing the same abstract allocations.
